title_zh: Anthropic 启动上市路演，拟以每股 70 至 78 美元发行
content_zh:
Anthropic 宣布启动首次公开募股路演，拟在纳斯达克以「ANT」为股票代码上市。11 月 10 日提交给美国证券交易委员会的修订招股书显示，发行价预计介于每股 70 美元与 78 美元之间。

按照完全稀释后的股本计算，Anthropic 最高估值约为 1.4 万亿美元；若不计入期权、限制性股票等潜在股份，估值则约为 1 万亿美元，较此前市场传出的 2 万亿美元 IPO 目标低近一半。

本次拟发行 8.25 亿股 A 类普通股，其中约 8.01 亿股由 Anthropic 新发，约 2365 万股由现有股东出售。出售旧股所得归相关股东。承销商还可在 30 天内向 Anthropic 额外购买最多约 1.24 亿股。

招股书还列出一笔与 IPO 配套的私募：谷歌、英伟达、AMD、博通、美光、微软和台积电旗下公司将在 IPO 完成后、满足约定条件时，按相同的每股发行价合计认购 260 亿美元的 N 类普通股。
title_en: Anthropic Launches IPO Roadshow Targeting Up to $1.4 Trillion Valuation
content_en:
Anthropic has officially launched the roadshow for its initial public offering (IPO) on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol "ANT." According to an updated prospectus filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on November 10, the company expects to price its shares between $70 and $78 per share.

At this price range, Anthropic's fully diluted valuation reaches up to $1.4 trillion (or approximately $1 trillion excluding options and restricted stock), roughly half of earlier market rumors targeting a $2 trillion valuation. The offering comprises 825 million Class A common shares, with 801 million newly issued by Anthropic and 23.65 million sold by existing shareholders. Underwriters also hold an option to purchase up to an additional 124 million shares within 30 days.

Additionally, major tech titans—including Google, Nvidia, AMD, Broadcom, Micron, Microsoft, and an affiliate of TSMC—have agreed to purchase $26 billion worth of Class N common shares in a concurrent private placement at the final IPO price, subject to customary closing conditions.

title_zh: 华为小折叠电脑 MateBook Fold S 亮相，11 月 14 日开启预订
content_zh:
华为公布了鸿蒙折叠屏电脑 MateBook Fold S 的外观和预订时间。新机提供云海蓝、天际白和幻夜黑三种配色，机身外侧配有一块名为「Live 小方屏」的屏幕。

华为终端的预热视频用信封展示了机器折叠后的体积。新机将于 11 月 14 日 10:08 开启预订，华为同时邀请消费者到店体验。
title_en: Huawei Unveils Compact Foldable Laptop MateBook Fold S, Pre-Orders Open Nov 14
content_en:
Huawei has officially revealed the design and pre-order schedule for its new HarmonyOS-powered foldable laptop, the MateBook Fold S. The device will be available in three colorways: Cloud Blue, Sky White, and Phantom Black. It features a compact secondary display on the exterior, dubbed the "Live Square Screen."

A teaser video highlighted the device's remarkably slim footprint when folded, comparing its size to a standard envelope. Pre-orders for the MateBook Fold S are set to open on November 14 at 10:08 AM (CST), alongside in-store hands-on experiences across Huawei retail locations.

title_zh: Google 开放最强 AI 模型 Gemini 4 Carbon
content_zh:
Google 宣布，正式向开发者、企业、科研人员及普通用户开放新一代 AI 模型 Gemini 4 Carbon。此前，该模型于 10 月 28 日发布，最初仅通过 Fairwind 计划向部分网络安全防御人员开放。

在第三方工作流基准测试中，Google 称 Carbon 在 CursorBench 4.0、Perplexity WANDR 和 Zapier AutomationBench 三项测试中均排名第一，单项任务成本比表现次优的外部模型低 2 倍以上。

目前，开发者和企业可以通过 Google AI Studio 的 Gemini API（付费套餐）及 Gemini for Business 使用 Carbon。普通用户则需要订阅 Google AI Ultra，才能在 Gemini App 和 Google 搜索的 AI Mode 中体验。

Google Antigravity 也向 Google AI Ultra 用户开放了模型使用权限。

价格方面，Carbon 目前采用与 Argon 相同的首发价格，每百万输入 token 2 美元、每百万输出 token 10 美元。优惠期将于 11 月 30 日结束，之后价格将分别调整至 4 美元和 20 美元。
title_en: Google Broadens Access to Flagship Gemini 4 Carbon AI Model
content_en:
Google has officially opened general access to its next-generation AI model, Gemini 4 Carbon, making it available to developers, enterprise clients, researchers, and everyday users. Originally introduced on October 28, the model was initially restricted to select cybersecurity defenders participating in the Fairwind initiative.

In third-party workflow benchmarks, Google reported that Carbon secured top performance across CursorBench 4.0, Perplexity WANDR, and Zapier AutomationBench. The company emphasized that the model delivers these top-tier results at less than half the cost per task compared to the next best competing model.

Developers and businesses can now access Carbon via the Gemini API (paid tiers) in Google AI Studio and through Gemini for Business. Individual users can experience the model via the Gemini App, Search AI Mode, and Google Antigravity by subscribing to Google AI Ultra.

Introductory pricing matches the Argon model at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens through November 30, after which rates will adjust to $4 and $20 per million tokens, respectively.

title_zh: 台积电 10 月营收创今年单月新高，同比增长近六成
content_zh:
台积电公布 10 月合并净营收为 5868.9 亿新台币，同比增长 59.7%。9 月同比增幅为 54.6%，10 月营收也超过了此前 8 月创下的今年单月最高值。

今年前 10 个月，台积电合并净营收合计 4.485617 万亿新台币，同比增长 43.3%。
title_en: TSMC Reports Record Monthly Revenue for October, Up Nearly 60% YoY
content_en:
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC) reported consolidated net revenue of NT$586.89 billion for October, marking a 59.7% year-on-year increase and setting a new single-month high for the year, surpassing its previous record set in August.

For the first 10 months of the year, TSMC's cumulative net revenue reached NT$4.485 trillion, representing a 43.3% increase compared to the same period last year.

title_zh: 阿里巴巴拟分拆平头哥，芯片子公司已向港交所递表
content_zh:
阿里巴巴 11 月 10 日公告，拟分拆全资芯片子公司平头哥，让其在港交所主板独立上市。港交所已确认阿里可以推进分拆，平头哥于 9 月 11 日以保密方式递交上市申请。

公告列出的方案是全球发售 H 股，包括香港公开发售，以及向机构和专业投资者配售。平头哥为数据中心提供芯片与系统级计算方案。阿里称，独立上市有助于平头哥直接进入股权和债务市场。分拆仍须取得港交所上市委员会批准，并完成中国证监会备案。
title_en: Alibaba to Spin Off Chip Unit T-Head for Hong Kong IPO
content_en:
Alibaba Group announced on November 10 its plan to spin off its wholly-owned semiconductor unit, T-Head, for an independent listing on the Main Board of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (HKEX). The HKEX has confirmed that Alibaba can proceed with the spin-off, following T-Head's confidential application submitted on September 11.

The proposed IPO involves a global offering of H-shares, including a public offering in Hong Kong and an international placement for institutional investors. T-Head specializes in chips and system-level computing solutions for data centers. Alibaba stated that the independent listing will allow T-Head direct access to equity and debt capital markets. The transaction remains subject to HKEX approval and CSRC registration.

title_zh: 奥迪与上汽合作项目 CEO 称，AUDI 未来三年将推三款新车
content_zh:
奥迪与上汽战略合作项目 CEO 舒睿泽向第一财经表示，AUDI 字母标品牌未来三年将推出三款新车，规划已进入执行阶段。谈及是否出口欧洲，他表示，相关车型面向中国消费者开发，未来几年的核心任务仍是中国市场。

按照奥迪此前公布的规划，上海的奥迪创新技术中心负责从整车概念到量产交付的开发。奥迪与上汽将基于第二代智能数字平台联合开发四款新车，首款计划于 2028 年推出。AUDI 现有产品包括 E5 Sportback 和 E7X。
title_en: Audi-SAIC Venture to Launch Three New 'AUDI' Models Over Next Three Years
content_en:
Fermín Soneira, CEO of the Audi-SAIC strategic project, announced that the new letter-badged "AUDI" brand will introduce three new models over the next three years, with the plan now in its execution phase. He emphasized that these models are developed specifically for Chinese consumers, keeping China as the core focus for the coming years.

Under Audi's roadmap, the Audi Innovation Technology Center in Shanghai is responsible for development from concept to mass delivery. Audi and SAIC are co-developing four models based on a second-generation intelligent digital platform, with the first vehicle scheduled for release in 2028. The AUDI brand portfolio currently includes the E5 Sportback and E7X.

title_zh: Oura 拟以 6.25 亿美元收购 Counsel Health，将医生服务接入健康数据
content_zh:
智能戒指厂商 Oura 宣布签署收购 Counsel Health 的最终协议，现金对价为 6.25 亿美元，并设有购买价格调整条款，预计在今年年底前完成交易。

Counsel 将医疗 AI 与自有医生团队结合。用户可在 Oura App 内根据戒指记录的生理数据向 AI 咨询，必要时转接医生，获得诊断、处方或转诊服务。双方计划继续扩展预防、急性病及专科和慢性病管理；Counsel 也会继续服务 Oura 之外的企业合作伙伴。

Oura 同时披露初步、未经审计的业绩：截至 9 月 30 日的第四财季营收为 5.33 亿美元，同比增长 153%；2026 财年营收约 17.5 亿美元，同比增长 92%。第四财季经调整 EBITDA 为 8700 万美元，利润率为 16%。公司称现有会员已超过 600 万人。
title_en: Oura to Acquire Counsel Health for $625M to Integrate Telehealth with Wearable Data
content_en:
Smart ring maker Oura has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Counsel Health for $625 million in cash, with the transaction expected to close by the end of the year. Counsel combines medical AI with an in-house physician team, allowing Oura app users to consult AI about their biometric data and seamlessly connect with doctors for diagnoses, prescriptions, and specialist referrals.

Alongside the acquisition announcement, Oura disclosed strong preliminary financial performance. The company reported Q4 revenue of $533 million—a 153% year-over-year increase—and projects full-year FY2026 revenue to reach approximately $1.75 billion, bolstered by an active membership base surpassing 6 million users.

title_zh: 💡 派拉蒙天舞 CEO：AI 工具或让片商更敢为新人导演下注
content_zh:
在派拉蒙天舞最新一场财报电话会上，首席执行官大卫·埃里森表示，AI 工具可以帮助降低电影制作成本，让片商更愿意为新人导演和原创故事承担风险。

埃里森以詹姆斯·卡梅隆早期拍摄的《终结者》为例。他认为，今天按同样的镜头逐一重拍，制作成本会比当时高得多。面对一部由新人执导、尚未有大明星撑场的原创电影，片商很难按这样的预算押注。AI 工具如果能让预算降到更容易接受的水平，类似项目就可能更容易开拍。

他还把 AI 与上世纪 90 年代初的电脑特效和数字合成相比。《侏罗纪公园》和《终结者 2》是他用来说明制作工具如何拓宽电影叙事的两个例子。在同一场电话会上，埃里森将 AI 的角色界定为供创作者使用的工具。

同一场问答也涉及 AI 会怎样改变观众寻找内容的方式。埃里森把流媒体的用途落在个性化推荐、内容发现和用户留存。他同时认为，即使制作工具越来越普及，由创作者主导打磨的故事和成熟的系列 IP 仍有价值。
title_en: Paramount Skydance CEO: AI Tools Could Help Studios Take Risks on New Directors
content_en:
During a recent earnings call, Paramount Skydance CEO David Ellison stated that AI tools could significantly lower film production costs, encouraging studios to take greater financial risks on emerging directors and original concepts. Drawing parallels to the breakthrough of CGI in the early 1990s, Ellison emphasized that AI serves as a tool to empower creators rather than replace them.

He cited James Cameron's early work on *The Terminator* as an example, noting that producing a similar original project today with an unproven director would be financially daunting at current budget levels. By lowering cost barriers, AI could help greenlight more high-risk, creative projects. Ellison added that even as production tools become democratized, creator-driven storytelling and established intellectual property will retain their core value.

title_zh: 宝马新世代 iX3 本月开启交付，i3 将在广州车展上市
content_zh:
宝马公布两款新世代纯电车型在中国的上市安排。新世代 BMW iX3 将于 11 月 25 日正式上市，已预订的客户可转为大定，车辆也将陆续交付。新世代 BMW i3 则定于 11 月 27 日在广州车展上市并开启订购。

新世代 i3 是宝马新世代平台的首款轿车，采用全国统一价，上市后可直接下大定，计划于 2027 年第一季度陆续交付。新车搭载第六代 BMW eDrive 电驱、全景 iDrive，以及宝马与 Momenta 联合开发的驾驶辅助系统。

宝马还将在车展上首次向中国公众展示 BMW 7 系的双质感定制涂装，同一车身结合高光和哑光两种表面。新一代 MINI COUNTRYMAN 也将在现场迎来中国首秀。
title_en: BMW Unveils China Launch Timeline for Neue Klasse iX3 and i3 Electric Vehicles
content_en:
BMW has outlined the China launch schedule for its next-generation Neue Klasse electric vehicles. The all-new BMW iX3 will officially launch on November 25, allowing pre-order holders to finalize their purchases ahead of upcoming deliveries. Meanwhile, the Neue Klasse i3 sedan is set to launch on November 27 at the Guangzhou Auto Show, with nationwide customer deliveries scheduled for the first quarter of 2027.

As the first sedan built on the Neue Klasse platform, the i3 features BMW's sixth-generation eDrive system, Panoramic iDrive display, and an advanced driving assistance system co-developed with Momenta. BMW will also use the Guangzhou Auto Show to debut a dual-texture custom paint option for the 7 Series and showcase the new MINI Countryman to the Chinese market.

title_zh: 曝苹果开发「Harbor」，可将多台 Mac 的统一内存用于本地 AI 推理
content_zh:
开发者 Aaron Perris 发现，苹果正在开发名为 Harbor 的 Mac 应用，目前以 Claris 品牌进行私人预览，目标是让用户直接在 Apple 芯片 Mac 上运行开放权重模型。

Perris 公布的介绍显示，Harbor 可在应用内浏览、下载和加载模型；两台或更多支持 Thunderbolt 5 的 Mac 连接后，应用可自动识别设备并组建集群，将统一内存汇集为推理资源，用于运行超出单机容量的模型，或承载更多并发请求。

这份介绍强调本地处理：数据保留在用户自己的硬件上，模型管理和集群设置由应用完成。9to5Mac 称，这款应用的定位是降低搭建私人 AI 推理服务器的门槛。
title_en: Apple Reportedly Developing 'Harbor' App to Cluster Mac Unified Memory for Local AI Inference
content_en:
Apple is reportedly developing a new Mac application named "Harbor," currently in private preview under the Claris brand, according to developer Aaron Perris. The app is designed to lower the barrier for setting up private AI inference servers, enabling users to run open-weight AI models locally on Apple Silicon Macs while keeping their data completely secure on local hardware.

Harbor allows users to browse, download, and manage AI models directly within the application. Crucially, when two or more Thunderbolt 5-supported Macs are connected, Harbor automatically detects the devices and clusters them together. This pools their unified memory into a powerful shared resource, enabling users to run massive models that exceed single-machine limits or handle higher volumes of concurrent requests.

title_zh: 大晓机器人在酒店演示从客房取衣到洗烘送回
content_zh:
大晓机器人展示了酒店洗衣场景中的一套机器人工作流程。机器人到客房取衣，穿过走廊进入洗衣区，操作洗衣机和烘干机，最后把衣物装篮送回客房。

团队先用客房、走廊、电梯和洗衣房的多视角照片重建训练环境，把衣物、衣篮和设备纳入可模拟接触与碰撞的三维场景。到了现场，通用模型负责探索任务做法，经过验证的动作被做成可复用技能，再由机器人按订单调用。

烘干机取衣是其中一项单独测试。团队用约 57 小时进行了 165 轮真机实验，根据录像和测量数据调整抓取角度与抬起高度。大晓称，在牛仔裤取衣测试中，留在筒内的衣物比例从平均 48% 降至 32%。
title_en: Daxiao Robotics Demonstrates End-to-End Hotel Laundry Automation
content_en:
Daxiao Robotics has demonstrated a fully automated hotel laundry workflow. The robot collects laundry from guest rooms, navigates corridors and elevators to the laundry area, operates washing and drying machines, and returns the cleaned clothes back to the guest rooms in a basket.

To prepare the robot, the team reconstructed a 3D digital twin of the environment—including rooms, corridors, elevators, and laundry machines—from multi-angle photos to simulate physical contacts and collisions. On-site, general AI models determine task execution strategies, translating successful maneuvers into reusable skill routines that the robot deploys based on service requests.

In targeted tests focused on unloading clothes from dryer drums, the team conducted 165 real-world trials over 57 hours to refine grabbing angles and lift heights. Daxiao reported that these adjustments reduced the uncollected garment rate in jeans retrieval tests from an average of 48% down to 32%.

title_zh: 小鹏汇天带「陆地航母」亮相里斯本，展示可分离飞行器
content_zh:
小鹏汇天创始人赵德力在里斯本 Web Summit 开幕环节展示了分体式飞行汽车「陆地航母」。这款产品由六轮陆行体和可收纳的飞行器组成，飞行器可与地面车辆分开使用，面向个人低空飞行。

据凤凰网科技报道，赵德力预计，未来十年飞行汽车产业会进入高速发展期，应用场景会从个人飞行体验扩展至城际交通。小鹏汇天还在规划面向多人和城际出行的 A868，采用全倾转混合动力方案，按六座布局开发。
title_en: XPENG AEROHT Showcases Modular 'Land Aircraft Carrier' at Lisbon Web Summit
content_en:
XPENG AEROHT founder Zhao Deli showcased the company's modular flying car, the "Land Aircraft Carrier," at the opening of the Web Summit in Lisbon. Designed for personal low-altitude flight, the vehicle features a six-wheeled ground carrier and a detachable, storable eVTOL aircraft.

Zhao expects the flying car industry to enter a phase of rapid growth over the next decade, with applications expanding from personal recreational flight to broader intercity transportation. To target this future market, XPENG AEROHT is developing the A868, a six-seat aircraft utilizing a full-tilt hybrid powertrain for multi-passenger intercity mobility.

title_zh: Blender 5.3 上线，可直接导入和渲染三维高斯泼溅
content_zh:
开源三维创作软件 Blender 5.3 的正式安装包已上线。新版本加入对三维高斯泼溅的初步支持，可以在 Blender 里处理用照片重建的三维场景，并把它们与其他场景对象一起使用。

新版可导入 PLY、SPZ 文件，也能从 USD 场景载入高斯泼溅。导入 PLY 文件时，Blender 会根据几何数据和属性判断它是否为高斯泼溅。导入后的数据以点云承载，可用几何节点调整，并在 Workbench、EEVEE 和 Cycles 中渲染。
title_en: Blender 5.3 Released with Native 3D Gaussian Splatting Import and Rendering
content_en:
The official release of Blender 5.3, the open-source 3D creation suite, is now available. This update introduces preliminary support for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), enabling artists and developers to directly import, manipulate, and combine photo-reconstructed 3D scenes with traditional 3D objects.

Blender 5.3 supports importing 3DGS assets via PLY and SPZ files, as well as loading them directly from USD scenes. When importing PLY files, Blender automatically identifies Gaussian Splatting data based on its geometry and attributes. Once imported, the data is represented as point clouds, which can be edited using Geometry Nodes and rendered across the Workbench, EEVEE, and Cycles engines.

title_zh: 蚂蚁灵波开源触觉模型，让机器人的「手感」跨硬件复用
content_zh:
蚂蚁灵波开源了面向机器人灵巧操作的触觉基础模型 LingBot-Touch，同步发布模型权重、代码和技术报告。模型覆盖压阻、磁触觉和视触觉三类传感器，把不同硬件采集的接触信号转换成统一的触觉表征，供机器人的控制模型使用。

团队用 4983 小时的触觉记录做预训练，数据约有 13.3 亿帧。在两款灵巧手的 26 项真实任务上，团队分别比较了原始控制模型、加入原始触觉信号和接入 LingBot-Touch 特征的表现，每项任务测试 20 次。项目页展示了机器人用钥匙开锁、按压力挤牙膏和沿封口压合密封袋的实机演示。
title_en: Ant Group Open-Sources LingBot-Touch to Standardize Robotic Tactile Perception Across Hardware
content_en:
Ant Group’s Lingbo team has open-sourced LingBot-Touch, a tactile foundation model designed for robotic dexterous manipulation, alongside its model weights, code, and technical report. The model unifies contact signals from piezoresistive, magnetic, and vision-based tactile sensors into a standardized tactile representation for downstream robot control models.

Pre-trained on approximately 1.33 billion frames across 4,983 hours of tactile data, LingBot-Touch significantly improves cross-hardware compatibility. The team evaluated the model across 26 real-world tasks using two different dexterous hands, demonstrating practical applications such as unlocking doors with keys, squeezing toothpaste with controlled force, and sealing ziplock bags.

title_zh: OPPO Watch 5 方表开放预约，11 月 16 日发布
content_zh:
OPPO Watch 5 已在官方商城开启预约，将于 11 月 16 日 19:00 发布。OPPO 将它称为「轻薄小方表」，新品采用圆角方形表盘，右侧有一枚旋钮。

官方商城列出奇遇紫、月光白、星耀黑、仙踪绿和心愿橙五款配色。Watch 5 将与 Reno17 系列手机及 Pad Air6 平板同场发布。
title_en: OPPO Watch 5 Opens for Reservations Ahead of November 16 Launch
content_en:
OPPO has officially opened reservations for the OPPO Watch 5 on its official online store ahead of its launch event on November 16 at 19:00 (CST). Positioned as a lightweight, sleek square smartwatch, the device features a rounded rectangular dial with a physical rotating crown on the right side.

The smartwatch will be available in five colorways: Adventure Purple, Moonlight White, Starry Black, Emerald Green, and Wish Orange. The OPPO Watch 5 will officially debut alongside the new Reno17 smartphone series and the Pad Air6 tablet.

title_zh: 波士顿动力给 Atlas 装上滑板车轮，实机完成 360 度跳转
content_zh:
波士顿动力公布了人形机器人 Atlas 的轮式实验。工程师用定制转接件，把现成的滑板车轮装到 Atlas 原有的踝关节执行器上。装上轮子后，机器人要在起步、转弯和刹停时持续带着负载运转，团队借此测试电机与全身控制策略的配合。

视频里的 360 度跳转来自一段真人动作捕捉。控制策略在模拟中学习追踪这段动作，第一次上实机就完成了跳转。练习侧移时，策略还学会用车轮滚过原本需要脚底滑动的一段动作。波士顿动力称，实验所得已开始用于标准配置的 Atlas。
title_en: Boston Dynamics Fits Atlas with Scooter Wheels, Executes 360-Degree Jump
content_en:
Boston Dynamics has unveiled a wheeled experiment featuring its humanoid robot, Atlas. Engineers attached off-the-shelf scooter wheels to the robot's ankle actuators via custom adapters to test how its motors and full-body control strategies handle continuous loads during starting, turning, and stopping.

Trained in simulation using human motion-capture data, Atlas successfully executed a 360-degree jump on its very first physical trial. During lateral movement tests, the control policy even learned to roll the wheels through sequences that typically required feet to slide. Boston Dynamics confirmed that insights from these experiments are already being integrated into standard Atlas configurations.

title_zh: MiniMax 开放 H3-Image 权重，可直接生成 4096 × 4096 图像
content_zh:
MiniMax 11 月 10 日发布图像模型 H3-Image，并在 Hugging Face 开放权重。模型支持根据文字生成图像，也能用一张或多张参考图做编辑。MiniMax 称，在其公布的测试条件下，模型约 10 秒可生成一张 4096 × 4096 像素的图像。

MiniMax 同时给出了本地部署文档，列出 SGLang、vLLM、Diffusers 和 ComfyUI 等推理框架。官方模型卡展示了本地生成与 API 结果的对照，其中包括按参考图去掉人物耳机并调整动作的编辑示例。
title_en: MiniMax Open-Sources H3-Image Model for Ultra-High Resolution Generation
content_en:
AI startup MiniMax has open-sourced the weights for its latest image generation model, H3-Image, now available on Hugging Face. The model supports text-to-image creation as well as editing via single or multiple reference images, generating high-resolution 4096 × 4096 outputs in approximately 10 seconds under test conditions.

Alongside the release, MiniMax provided local deployment documentation supporting popular inference frameworks like SGLang, vLLM, Diffusers, and ComfyUI. Official samples demonstrate powerful editing capabilities, such as removing headphones from a subject or altering poses while maintaining consistency with reference images.

title_zh: Adobe 更新 Photoshop 和 Premiere，修图可连同倒影一起移除
content_zh:
Adobe 在 11 月 10 日的 MAX 大会上发布 Creative Cloud 更新。Photoshop 的移除工具可识别与目标相关的脚印、倒影和阴影，移除主体时一并处理这些痕迹。新增的 Relight 可以给画面加光，并调整光源位置、颜色和亮度。

Premiere 的时间轴新增生成视频、音效和配乐等选项，编辑可在剪辑过程中补齐缺失素材。新的 Color Mode 已正式开放，生成式移除工具则以测试版提供，用户可用遮罩追踪穿帮的物体，再让软件补全画面。
title_en: Adobe Updates Photoshop and Premiere with Context-Aware AI Object Removal
content_en:
At its annual MAX conference, Adobe announced major Creative Cloud updates focused on smarter AI editing for Photoshop and Premiere Pro. Photoshop's enhanced Remove Tool can now automatically detect and erase contextual elements tied to a subject—such as footprints, reflections, and shadows. A new "Relight" feature also allows editors to add custom lighting and fine-tune its position, color, and intensity.

Meanwhile, Premiere Pro expands its timeline capabilities with options to generate missing video clips, sound effects, and background music directly within projects. The update officially launches a new Color Mode alongside a beta generative removal tool that enables editors to track unwanted objects with masks and seamlessly reconstruct the background.

title_zh: Claude 推出原生表格和白板，团队可在对话里共同编辑
content_zh:
Anthropic 发布 Claude Whiteboards 和 Claude Sheets 测试版，并将此前的 Claude Dashboards 正式更名为 Claude Data、转为正式服务。三款工具覆盖所有付费套餐，支持网页、桌面和手机端。

Whiteboards 可把口头讨论整理成带负责人和日期的时间线，也能将团队的便笺按主题归类、生成行动项。用户可框选白板局部向 Claude 提问，再将内容转为文档、幻灯片，或转到 Miro、Lucid 等合作工具继续编辑。

Sheets 支持生成带多个工作表、公式、格式和下拉菜单的表格，并标示每次修改，团队成员可共同编辑。当前提供基础表格功能，需要完整 Excel 功能时可导出 .xlsx 或 CSV。Claude Data 则增加认证查询、实时共享、缓存和版本回退，使用时需接入数据仓库或 CRM。

Team 套餐默认开启三款工具；Enterprise 默认关闭白板和表格，Claude Data 将于 11 月 19 日默认开启，管理员可调整。
title_en: Anthropic Introduces Native Sheets and Whiteboards in Claude for Real-Time Team Collaboration
content_en:
Anthropic has launched the beta versions of Claude Whiteboards and Claude Sheets while officially renaming Claude Dashboards to Claude Data as a fully available service. Available across web, desktop, and mobile platforms, all three tools are included across all paid subscription tiers.

Claude Whiteboards enables teams to organize verbal discussions into structured timelines complete with assignees and dates, group sticky notes by topic, and automatically generate action items. Users can select specific sections of a whiteboard to prompt Claude, convert content into documents or presentations, or export seamlessly to third-party tools like Miro and Lucid.

Claude Sheets introduces collaborative spreadsheet capabilities, supporting multiple tabs, formulas, custom formatting, dropdown menus, and revision tracking. While currently providing core spreadsheet features, users can export files as `.xlsx` or `.csv` for advanced Excel functionality. Meanwhile, Claude Data adds authenticated queries, real-time sharing, caching, and version rollbacks when connected to data warehouses or CRMs.

All three tools are enabled by default for Team plan users. For Enterprise accounts, Whiteboards and Sheets are disabled by default, while Claude Data will be turned on by default starting November 19, with full admin control over access settings.

title_zh: ChatGPT 开放商家认领，美国部分商家可上线客服智能体
content_zh:
OpenAI 推出 Businesses in ChatGPT 测试版，允许商家通过 Business Hub 认领并验证企业身份，更新商家资料、商品价格和库存信息。ChatGPT 已开放地区的合资格企业可以申请，Shopify 商家还可从 Business Hub 或 Shopify 后台连接店铺、简化验证。

商家后台提供被提及次数、网站点击次数及用户发现商家的话题等汇总数据。OpenAI 表示，这些统计需达到一定的会话或互动门槛，不向商家分享用户的 ChatGPT 对话或 Business Agent 聊天内容。

认领后，美国合资格电商和在线服务企业可创建、测试并上线 Business Agent。当商家出现在 ChatGPT 回答中，用户可以进入其资料页，选择与商家智能体继续询问产品和服务。该会话带有明确标识，并与原来的 ChatGPT 对话分开。商家也可将智能体设为 ChatGPT 广告的跳转入口，赞助展示会单独标注。
title_en: OpenAI Launches 'Businesses in ChatGPT' Beta, Enabling Brands to Deploy AI Customer Service Agents
content_en:
OpenAI has introduced the beta version of "Businesses in ChatGPT," allowing eligible businesses to claim and verify their brand identity through the new Business Hub. Verified merchants can update their company profiles, product pricing, and inventory details. Shopify merchants can streamline verification by directly connecting their stores through either the Business Hub or the Shopify admin panel.

The platform provides merchants with aggregated analytics, including brand mentions, website clicks, and topics through which users discover them. OpenAI emphasized that these insights require a minimum interaction threshold and that raw ChatGPT conversations or Business Agent chat logs will not be shared with merchants to protect user privacy.

Once verified, eligible U.S. e-commerce and online service companies can build, test, and deploy custom Business Agents. When a brand appears in ChatGPT responses, users can visit its profile and interact directly with its agent for inquiries regarding products and services. These sessions are clearly labeled and separated from standard ChatGPT chats. Additionally, merchants can set their agents as landing destinations for ChatGPT advertisements, which will be distinctly marked as sponsored.

title_zh: 《GTA VI》开启预载，Xbox One 发售日可通过云游戏游玩
content_zh:
Rockstar 于 11 月 10 日宣布《GTA VI》开启预载，并公布了主机版的运行目标。游戏在 PS5、PS5 Pro 和 Xbox Series X|S 上以 30 帧每秒为目标，PS5 Pro 额外支持 PSSR 超分辨率和光线追踪阴影。

游戏将于 11 月 19 日发售。届时 Xbox One 和 Xbox Series X|S 都可通过 Xbox Cloud Gaming 游玩，云端采用 Xbox Series S 的画质设置。游戏也支持 PlayStation 和 Xbox 的远程游玩功能。
title_en: GTA VI Pre-Loads Go Live Ahead of Nov. 19 Launch, Details Console Performance and Cloud Gaming Support
content_en:
Rockstar Games announced on November 10 that pre-loading for *Grand Theft Auto VI* is now live, alongside target performance metrics for console platforms. The game aims for 30 frames per second on PlayStation 5, PlayStation 5 Pro, and Xbox Series X|S. On PS5 Pro, the title will feature additional enhancements, including PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR) upscaling and ray-traced shadows.

Set for release on November 19, *GTA VI* will also be playable at launch via Xbox Cloud Gaming on both Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S, utilizing cloud instances configured with Xbox Series S graphical settings. Furthermore, standard Remote Play functionality will be supported across both PlayStation and Xbox consoles.

title_zh: 12 月起，帮别人买火车票也能代开电子发票
content_zh:
国家税务总局与国铁集团公布铁路电子发票的新办理方式。12 月 1 日起，通过铁路 12306 帮他人买票、退票或改签的人，可以在行程结束或支付退票、改签费用后，直接在铁路 12306 为旅客开具电子发票。

在线下，代买车票后，购票人可当场凭自己或乘车人的有效身份证件到售票窗口申领「扫码开票单」。代办退票或改签时，则须当场出示乘车人购票时使用的有效身份证件。旅客本人也可凭有效身份证件在窗口或自助售票机申领开票单。

电子发票还将新增白底样式，票面信息与原来的蓝底版一致，可按需选择。
title_en: China's Railway System to Allow E-Invoicing for Third-Party Ticket Purchases Starting December
content_en:
Starting December 1, purchasing train tickets for others in China will become more convenient, as China State Railway Group and the State Taxation Administration introduce expanded electronic invoicing options. Users buying, refunding, or changing tickets on behalf of others via the official 12306 platform will be able to issue e-invoices directly for passengers once the trip is completed or transaction fees are settled.

For offline transactions, ticket buyers can request a QR code invoice receipt at ticket counters by presenting a valid ID—either their own or the passenger’s. When requesting invoices for ticket refunds or changes, the passenger’s original ID used for purchase must be shown. Passengers can also obtain invoice receipts directly at service windows or self-service kiosks.

To complement the existing blue-themed e-invoices, a new white-background design will also be introduced, offering users additional visual options while delivering identical invoice details.

title_zh: 金鸡电影节首设 AI 单元，《无人知晓》获极客松首位推荐
content_zh:
首届金鸡电影 AI 单元在厦门公布两份荣誉推荐名单。征片计划的「年度 AI 作品」推荐荣誉由《合龙》获得，《无人知晓》获现场限时创作环节「AI 极客松」首位推荐。

征片计划分为 AI 原生叙事、实拍与 AI 融合、AI 动画三个方向，共有 20 部作品入围。极客松则从 287 支报名队伍中选出 20 支，在厦门用 72 小时完成命题创作。获杰出剧本推荐的「尾号等风」团队成员黄敏萱提到，AI 能较快将手绘分镜转成动态影像，构思故事和判断画面效果仍由创作者完成。
title_en: Golden Rooster Film Festival Debuts AI Section; 'Nobody Knows' Takes Top Hackathon Honor
content_en:
The Golden Rooster Film Festival officially introduced its inaugural AI Unit in Xiamen, announcing two major honor lists. *The Confluence* secured the "AI Work of the Year" recommendation in the submission section, while *Nobody Knows* earned the top spot in the 72-hour live "AI Hackathon."

The submission track selected 20 shortlisted entries across three categories: AI-native narratives, live-action combined with AI, and AI animation. Meanwhile, the Hackathon selected 20 finalist teams out of 287 applicants to complete themed creative projects within 72 hours on site.

Participating creators noted the practical benefits of emerging tools, observing that while AI can rapidly turn hand-drawn storyboards into dynamic footage, the core creative responsibilities—such as narrative design and visual evaluation—remain firmly in human hands.

title_zh: 《指环王：力量之戒》第三季 11 月 11 日开播，凯勒鹏登场
content_zh:
《指环王：力量之戒》第三季定于 11 月 11 日在 Prime Video 开播，首日上线四集。曾在《怪奇物语》中出演维克那的杰米·坎贝尔·鲍尔加入剧组，饰演凯兰崔尔失散已久的丈夫凯勒鹏。

新一季来到埃瑞吉安陷落五年之后，索伦正在魔多打造至尊魔戒，精灵、矮人和人类仍在各自抵抗他的军队。第五、六集将在 11 月 18 日上线，最后两集定于 11 月 25 日播出。
title_en: 'The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power' Season 3 Set for Nov 11 Premiere with Celeborn Debut
content_en:
The third season of *The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power* is scheduled to premiere on Prime Video on November 11, launching with a four-episode drop. Actor Jamie Campbell Bower, known for his role as Vecna in *Stranger Things*, joins the cast as Galadriel's long-lost husband, Celeborn.

Set five years after the fall of Eregion, the new season sees Sauron forging the One Ring in Mordor while Elves, Dwarves, and Men continue their desperate resistance against his forces.

Following the four-episode premiere, Episodes 5 and 6 will stream on November 18, with the final two episodes scheduled for release on November 25.

title_zh: 华纳筹拍新版《电子情书》，《回心转意》导演接手
content_zh:
据 Variety 确认，华纳兄弟正在重启 1998 年爱情喜剧《电子情书》，由《回心转意》导演 Jason Orley 执导。他正基于 Deborah Kaplan 和 Harry Elfont 的早期版本改写剧本，Neal Moritz 与 Tania Landau 将通过 Original Film 担任制片人。

原版由诺拉·艾芙蓉执导，汤姆·汉克斯与梅格·瑞恩主演：一家大型连锁书店的经营者与独立儿童书店女店主，在现实中是生意对手，却在不知对方身份的网络交流中相恋。

《电子情书》的故事源于米克洛什·拉斯洛 1937 年的舞台剧，此前也曾被改编为 1940 年电影《街角的商店》。Orley 曾执导《青春期》，并刚完成布丽·拉尔森、杰克·奎德等主演的新片《Close Personal Friends》的后期制作。
title_en: Warner Bros. Developing 'You've Got Mail' Remake with Director Jason Orley
content_en:
Warner Bros. is officially developing a reimagining of the classic 1998 romantic comedy *You've Got Mail*, as confirmed by *Variety*. Jason Orley (*I Want You Back*) has been tapped to direct and is currently rewriting a script initially penned by Deborah Kaplan and Harry Elfont. Neal Moritz and Tania Landau will produce the feature via Original Film.

The original 1998 hit, directed by Nora Ephron, starred Tom Hanks and Meg Ryan as rival bookstore owners in New York City who unknowingly fell in love over anonymous email exchanges.

The timeless premise traces its roots back to Miklós László’s 1937 Hungarian play, which also inspired the 1940 romantic comedy *The Shop Around the Corner*. Orley previously directed *Big Time Adolescence* and recently wrapped post-production on *Close Personal Friends*, featuring an ensemble cast including Brie Larson and Jack Quaid.
